headline: Enzo Fernández: Dream to be at club as 'big' as Man City
description: Enzo Fernández said he had always dreamed of playing for "a club as big as Manchester City" in his first interview since completing his big-money transfer from Chelsea.

headline: Monaco CEO still looking for Folarin Balogun transfer after failed Everton move
description: Folarin Balogun could be forced to consider a move to a Turkey or Saudi Pro League club this week after Monaco said they are still looking to offload the contract of the USMNT forward following the collapse of his $45 million transfer to Everton.
